## Scores

<div id="fsp-list"></div>

<div id="fsp-head"></div>
<div id="fsp"></div>

## How to use a score

- **Play** (or Space) plays from the start, from a clicked note, or from a bar typed in the **Bar** box; Space again pauses.
- **Choose instruments** shows and plays only some of the orchestra; views can be saved by name.
- **Layout**: pages scrolling down, pages side by side (◀ ▶ or the arrow keys turn them), or one long line; bar numbers; bar lines through
  each family or the whole score; staff spacing even or kept apart; size, bar width and page height. Your layout is kept in this browser.
- **Even out the loudness** brings soft and loud passages, and solos and tutti, closer together, for hearing inner parts.

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  var BASE = "/apps/shared/data/full-scores/", V = "1";
  var id = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("id");
  function esc(s) { return String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, function (c) { return { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;" }[c]; }); }
  fetch(BASE + "index.json?v=" + V).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (list) {
    document.getElementById("fsp-list").innerHTML = "<ul>" + list.map(function (s) {
      return '<li><a href="?id=' + encodeURIComponent(s.id) + '">' + esc(s.composer + ": " + s.title + ", " + s.movement) + '</a><br><span class="fsp-sub">' + esc(s.orchestra) + "</span></li>";
    }).join("") + "</ul>";
    var s = list.filter(function (x) { return x.id === id; })[0];
    if (!s) return;
    document.getElementById("fsp-head").innerHTML = "<h2>" + esc(s.composer + ": " + s.title) + "</h2><p>" + esc(s.movement + " · " + s.orchestra) + "</p>";
    return Promise.all([fetch(BASE + s.abc + "?v=" + V).then(function (r) { return r.text(); }), s.notes ? fetch(BASE + s.notes + "?v=" + V).then(function (r) { return r.text(); }) : ""])
      .then(function (a) { window.score = FullScore.mount("#fsp", { abc: a[0], id: s.id, notes: a[1] }); });
  }).catch(function (e) { document.getElementById("fsp-list").textContent = "The score list did not load: " + e.message; });
})();
</script>
```
